rationale: The native materializer (build_native_view_tree) registers a DesignIR's existing fontFamilyAssets through the public pulp::canvas::register_font / register_font_woff2 under private per-unicode-range-segment aliases named from their content, and rewrites the tree's font-family stacks to list those aliases in place of the shipped family, last-defined segment first. A face whose file is missing or no longer matches the manifest hash is skipped with a font-asset-unavailable diagnostic. Adds a committed design-ir-observe fixture (a Chromium DPR-2 capture of a page serving Funnel Display Variable from a Blob URL) and its checks. Pulp-owned paths only: no Vellum-transferred slice, capture format, IR format, Chromium, packaging or framework authority moves.
